startCommand: node -e 'const{Pool}=require("pg"),c=require("crypto");(async()=>{const p=new Pool({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL,max:1}),r=(await p.query("SELECT current_database() database_name,current_setting("+String.fromCharCode(39)+"server_version_num"+String.fromCharCode(39)+") server_version_num,(SELECT system_identifier::text FROM pg_control_system()) system_identifier")).rows[0],v={database_name:String(r.database_name),server_version_num:String(r.server_version_num),system_identifier:String(r.system_identifier)},b=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(v).sort(([a],[z])=>a.localeCompare(z)));console.log(JSON.stringify({event:"WORKER_DB_BINDING_PASS",deploy_sha:process.env.RENDER_GIT_COMMIT,binding_sha256:c.createHash("sha256").update(JSON.stringify(b)).digest("hex"),database_name_present:Boolean(v.database_name),server_version_present:Boolean(v.server_version_num),system_identifier_present:Boolean(v.system_identifier),mutation:false}));await p.end()})().catch(e=>{console.error("WORKER_DB_BINDING_FAIL",e.message);process.exit(1)})'
